title: Cube Battler: Story of Anna
native_title: キューブ・バトラー ～アンナ未来編～
overview:
Now, games surpass OVA!! Digital Battle Animation

This time the star is Anna Mirai!!

A new kind of fighting puzzle game where the story and battles are all animated

Cube Battler: Story of Anna is the follow-up to Story of Shou, retelling the adventure from the side of the cheerful girl Anna Mirai. Her story plays out in anime scenes, and every rival is faced in a puzzle battle.

Both fighters work on side-by-side playfields, turning picture cubes and placing them to rebuild the image playing in the background, while sending attacks at the opponent and guarding against theirs. Complete the picture first or wear down your rival's strength to win.

- Anime story scenes starring Anna
- One player story or two-player versus
- Memory backup saves

今、ゲームはOVAを超える!!
デジタルバトルアニメーション

今回の主役はアンナ未来!!

ストーリーとバトルの全てがアニメする新感覚格闘パズルゲーム
